description: Conversation content, addressed four ways (precedence: query and filters beat target-less modes and refuse target; around beats since): target alone reads it in full (a handle, '#channel', '@person', or a description); target+around fetches context around a timestamp; target+since renders a time window with triage; query searches (raw Slack syntax passes through as written; in=, from=, after=, before=, has=, thread= are resolved filters composed onto it). Read-only; never marks anything read.

after.description: search: YYYY-MM-DD (or 3d, 2w). Replaces the default window; not with timeframe

around.description: With target: a message timestamp to fetch context around (thread replies if it starts one)

cursor.description: Continuation cursor from a previous page

from.description: search: messages by these people; resolved through the person ladder, a miss returns candidates and does not search. Several entries compose as repeated from: clauses; Slack's OR/AND behavior for repeats is unverified

has.description: search: 'link', 'pin', or a reaction as ':emoji:' (Slack's has::emoji:). Other values (file, star, bare reaction) are unverified and rejected

in.description: search: narrow to a '#channel' or '@person' (DM); resolved by name, a miss returns candidates and does not search. Several entries compose as repeated in: clauses; Slack's OR/AND behavior for repeats is unverified

limit.description: Maximum messages. Per mode: bare target default 50 cap 200; around default 10 cap 100; since default 20 cap 50; ignored for query.

query.description: Search instead of fetch: raw Slack search text, passed to Slack as written (a from:@name typed here is NOT resolved or checked; use from= for resolution)

since.description: With target: a time window to catch up on ('2h', '1d', '30m') with triage highlighting

target.description: What to read: a handle from inbox, '#channel', '@person', or a description ('the deploy thread')

timeframe.description: search: how far back to search (default 1w); refused together with after=, before=, or a date operator (after:, before:, on:, during:) in query=

name: messages
